revised_comments: Development of Eswatini's national digital ID system is financed almost entirely through external development finance. The World Bank-financed Digital Eswatini project provides a US$65 million IBRD credit against a total project cost of US$65.16 million, of which approximately US$11.5 million is allocated to Digital Public Infrastructure — including digital ID — under the project's 'Government in Your Hand' component. As of mid-2026 the programme is in active implementation, with Ministry of ICT change agents being trained to roll it out across government. No comparable domestic budget allocation for the ID system's ongoing development has been identified, indicating the system remains primarily dependent on external funding rather than sustainable domestic resources.
